name: css-image-stacking
blurb: Full-page layout where images stack and layer on scroll using CSS sticky positioning.
description: Multiple sections with sticky positioning create a stacking card effect as viewport scrolls. Images grow wider and layer on top of each other. Uses ReactLenis for smooth scrolling.
use_when: Immersive storytelling or portfolio galleries with a modern, scroll-driven visual rhythm.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive pages or when strict browser compatibility is needed.
a11y: Images lack semantic alt text. Layout is scroll-dependent with no keyboard alternatives.
